issues.quote: Gross profit rose to $234.2 billion in fiscal 2024 from $270.0 billion in fiscal 2023, translating to a fiscal 2024 gross margin of 48.9%.
issues.problem: Amazon's FY2024 gross profit was about $311.7 billion, not $234.2 billion. $234.2B would be lower than FY2023's $270.0B, so it can't have 'risen', and it works out to a margin of about 36.7%, not 48.9%. The 48.9% margin only matches $311.7B.

data.summary: Revenue ($638.0B vs $574.8B, +11.0%), operating income ($68.6B vs $36.9B, 10.8% margin), net income ($59.2B vs $30.4B, +94.7%) and diluted EPS ($5.53 vs $2.90) are correct. The FY2024 gross profit is wrong: it was about $311.7B, not $234.2B. The wrong figure contradicts both the word 'rose' and the stated 48.9% margin.
